title: CEE-PII-Bench v0.2
sample_rule: per language, rows ordered by sha256('<seed>:<uid>'), first n convertible

label_mapping.label: postal
label_mapping.note: ADDRESS inside an address; a postcode on its own is policy-excluded

label_mapping.label: employer
label_mapping.note: ORGANIZATION is a keep type: scored for recall, never a leak

label_mapping.label: utr
label_mapping.note: UK tax and health numbers are ID_DOCUMENT

label_mapping.label: account_ref
label_mapping.note: a customer, policy or contract reference identifies a contract

label_mapping.label: aba
label_mapping.note: a routing number identifies a bank, not a person

label_mapping.label: ein
label_mapping.note: an employer identification number identifies a business

merge_rule: adjacent spans of one mapped type separated by <= 3 spaces/tabs/commas
notes: Synthetic, from a template generator with deliberate noise (stripped Hungarian diacritics, OCR confusions); about 14 % of the documents have no entities at all.
Written by another detector's authors as its own benchmark: a fair third-party set for pii-guard, though not for flowxai/cee-pii.
